title: ArcBio Continuous DNA Workflow - Pre-PCR Instrument: DNA-PRE-PCR-1 DNA Concentration Fragmentation
author: Opentrons
materials: Bead cleanup and elution with Tris.
Combine Fragmentation Master Mix and eluted sample. Continue with off-deck thermocycler steps.

steps.title: Bead cleanup and elution
steps.instruction: Perform bead cleanup on the DNA sample and elute the DNA using Tris buffer.

steps.title: Combine fragmentation mix
steps.instruction: Add the Fragmentation Master Mix to the eluted DNA sample and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Thermocycler incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to an off‑deck thermocycler and run the required fragmentation program.
